title: Full repository reachability and dead-artifact audit
document_role: Index. The per-file entries live in the shards listed under `shards` below; this file holds the method, the classification definitions, the counts and the coverage reconciliation. Every tracked path in the repository appears exactly once across the shards - as an explicit path, never as a glob or a group.
schema_version_2_change: Version 1 of this file assessed some artifacts as a class, with a `covers` count and grouped path expressions such as `tests/** (remaining test modules)`. Review rejected that: a class assessment cannot establish complete coverage, and grouping hid real differences. Version 2 drops `covers` entirely - one entry per tracked path - and splits the result into shards so each is reviewable in full rather than truncated. Expanding the groups changed four classifications; they are listed under `corrections_from_v1`.

method.reachability_definition: An artifact is ACTIVE only when a path exists from a current production entrypoint (a .github/workflows job step) to the code that opens or imports it. A mention in documentation, a test that reads the file, or the file's own claim about itself is never treated as a consumer. py_compile in a CI job is not execution.
method.model_message_definition: A product/config artifact counts as WIRED only when its content can be traced to the system/user strings handed to src.utils.llm_client.chat (or an injected transport of the same shape) on a path a production entrypoint reaches.
method.import_census: src/ reachability was established from a complete census of every `from src.<module>` and `import src.<module>` occurrence in src/ and scripts/, not from sampling.
method.dynamic_loading: Dynamically composed paths were traced rather than assumed dead. config/prompts/visibility/*.yaml are loaded through an f-string key (src/editorial/vi_pipeline.py:80) from the three values at src/strategy/models.py:70-72, and are WIRED despite having no literal path reference anywhere. data/strategy/visibility_queue.jsonl can change product behaviour with no code change at all (src/strategy/models.py:295-300).
method.counting: Counts below are files, and they reconcile to `git ls-files` - see `coverage`.
method.out_of_scope: Nothing was excluded as vendor or build output: this repository tracks no such directory. reports/content_packages/images/ is the only gitignored generated path and holds no tracked file.

classifications.ACTIVE_RUNTIME: Reachable from a current production entrypoint.
classifications.ACTIVE_SUPPORT: Required by tests, CI, tooling, build, fixtures or operational support, with a demonstrated consumer.
classifications.PRODUCT_CONFIG_WIRED: Authoritative product/config artifact with a proven production consumer.
classifications.PRODUCT_CONFIG_UNWIRED: Intended to control product/runtime behaviour; the required production chain is absent or incomplete.
classifications.HUMAN_DOCUMENTATION: Intentionally for people only; not represented as executable configuration.
classifications.LEGACY_INTENTIONAL: Retained deliberately; owner/reason identified and proven not to be an accidental active path.
classifications.DEAD_ORPHANED: No justified consumer or purpose could be demonstrated.
classifications.DUPLICATE_SUPERSEDED: Another artifact is authoritative; both are named.
classifications.SUSPICIOUS_UNRESOLVED: Purpose or reachability could not be established safely.

shards.form: classification record plus two exhaustive path manifests

coverage.reconciliation: 8399 is `git ls-files | wc -l` for the tree this PR produces: 8383 at commit 19bac01 plus the 16 new files this PR adds under reports/repository_audit/, all 16 of which are themselves inventoried in shard 11c.
coverage.if_the_count_drifts: If a later `git ls-files` returns more than 8399 and the extra paths are under reports/content_packages/<signal_id>/runs/, that is finding F5 reproducing itself - a test run wrote into the tracked tree and the additions were staged. Regenerate the 12a/12b manifests with the commands above rather than adjusting the totals by hand.
coverage.how_to_verify_a_shard: For any shard, `grep -oh '"path": "<area>/[^"]*"' <shard> | cut -d'"' -f4 | sort` diffed against `git ls-files <area> | sort` must be empty. Every shard in this manifest was checked that way.
coverage.how_to_verify_shard_12: `wc -l` on each manifest must equal 4702 and 3094, and the manifests must equal `git ls-files reports/content_packages/sig-test-001` and `git ls-files reports/content_packages/sig-identity-test-001`.
coverage.no_grouping_claim: No entry in any shard stands for more than one path: the v1 `covers` field is gone and no shard entry has one. The only place a classification is stated once for many paths is shard 12, where the paths are still enumerated one per line and the evidence is identical for each - the writer, the root cause and the absence of a consumer are the same file-for-file.

corrections_from_v1.why: It was grouped with signals_active.jsonl and selected_signals.jsonl, which do have production consumers. On its own it has none: no code, workflow or test opens it. It is kept deliberately, and .gitignore:18 states the reason in-band - which is what makes it LEGACY BUT INTENTIONAL rather than an orphan.

It was grouped with its three siblings as a declared prompt rule reference. It is not declared: strategy/current/business_strategy.json:306-342 names the other three and not this one. So it is neither wired nor declared-and-unwired - its purpose cannot be established.

It was grouped with five other docs/ files. It is declared at business_strategy.json:337-341 as prompt rule reference 'platform-visual-strategy' and nothing loads it, which is the same defect as config/brand_voice.md. Classifying it as human documentation understated finding F3 by one file.

All fourteen *_generated.json files were grouped as legacy flat artifacts. Six of them are not: scripts/generate_and_publish_visibility.py:426 writes the vis_* ones as current output of the Tuesday/Thursday stream. The suffix means two different things in one directory.

notes: The four corrections above are the direct value of the expansion: each is a real error that a grouped assessment produced and a per-file assessment caught. Aggregate counts are unchanged for PRODUCT_CONFIG_UNWIRED (9), PRODUCT_CONFIG_WIRED (17) and DUPLICATE_SUPERSEDED (2).
reports/ now holds 7,972 of 8,399 tracked files, and 7,824 of those are DEAD_ORPHANED. Finding F5 owns that; nothing was deleted by this issue.
Companion documents: reports/repository_audit/findings.json (ranked findings and repair order) and docs/repository-audit/REPOSITORY_AUDIT.md (the human report).
